about: Where each file under public/assets came from. Written by scripts/seed-asset-provenance.mjs and checked by scripts/checkPublicTree.mjs: every file must be covered by a folder rule or listed in an entry. Change "unknown" entries to "original" or "generated" (with "by": the script) once confirmed; reruns keep those.

sources.generated: Made by a script in this repository from no third-party art ("by" names it).
sources.vanilla: Mojang's art, identical by content hash to the PrismarineJS/minecraft-assets mirror.
sources.third-party: Made by someone else under an open license ("license" names it, "from" says where).
sources.vanilla-derived: Made by a script from vanilla files.
sources.unknown-modified: Named like a vanilla texture but changed or from another version; not yet confirmed.

packs/faithful_64x/.note: Vanilla block textures from public/assets/blocks, upscaled to 64x64 with added detail. Not the Faithful community pack.

entries.license: SIL Open Font License 1.1, text in fonts/PixelifySans-OFL.txt

entries.note: Named like a vanilla texture, but not identical to any in PrismarineJS/minecraft-assets: edited, regenerated by a script, or from another version.
No vanilla texture has this name: probably generated or drawn here. Confirm as original or generated (with the script).
